Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 6

“Though I am unborn and of imperishable nature, and though I am the Lord of beings, yet governing my own nature I come into being by my own power.”

Krishna distinguishes his appearing from ordinary birth. Beings are pushed into bodies by nature; he presides over his own and enters deliberately, which is the whole difference.
